title: Destinations and deliveries in the CLI
items: The CLI docs describe `whk destinations` (list, add, update, reorder, preview, test, secret, remove) and `whk deliveries` (the log, a request's deliveries, counts, redelivering one request or every failed one)
The agent skill points agents at those commands for forwarding, Google Sheets and file drops
Saving a file drop refuses an SFTP private key that stops before its `-----END` line, instead of failing at the first drop
